reuse.why: Reuses extractTagsFromText for the #fixed tag, the existing sum-amount sheet cells and getCategoryAverage, and the new action goes through the shared selection and sign helpers.

duplication.why: Selection and sign rules are defined once, but the category SELECT (with group notes and the template EXISTS) is written three times: getBudgetData, getAverageCategories and an inline near-copy in setZero.

placement.why: The selection predicate, sign helper and query live in budget/actions.ts beside the actions, and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Edits are confined to the month-wide actions, their registration, tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: isMonthWideCategory is the single point for every step's rule change; the remaining repeated SQL fragments (kept for join differences) are a small burden.

abstraction_drift.where: isMonthWideCategory gained only the requested includeHiddenCategories option; all month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg) call it; setZero keeps its own inline SELECT (LEFT join) rather than getAverageCategories, but still uses the shared predicate
